test_plan_markdown:
# R15 Condition/Qualification Preservation — Test Plan (Fable advisory, execution pending)

## Purpose
Discriminate full preservation of supported conditions/qualifications from coherent-but-incomplete extraction, inversion, scope leakage and serialization clipping, in source-only semantic inventories. Representation is unspecified. Structural validity is never evidence of semantic completeness.

## Scope rules
- Expected qualifications are grounded in exact fixture bytes. No fixed AST/schema. Alternative justified interpretations with explicit uncertainty are acceptable where the fixture marks ambiguity.
- Two tiers. **Tier A (deterministic):** authored fixtures with metadata-encoded condition atoms, inversion flags and planted losses; checks run offline on the implementation's output. **Tier B (discovery):** unseen-source runs; semantic completeness is advisory and needs AI/human review even where metadata automates a known loss.
- Every exposed bound B is probed at B-1, B, B+1. Unrepresentable content must yield an explicit bounded failure with no clipping, repair, or silent shortening.
- A serialization-limit failure (flagged, bounded) is scored separately from a semantic extraction omission (unflagged absence). Local byte/char/token estimates are not a matched-tokenizer guarantee.
- Regression pattern (public, outcome-exposed, supplied as data): broken qualification strings can survive completion and structural roundtrip. A broken string is not automatically an absent source function; check whether the constraint survives elsewhere.
- No live experiment. Claude route is the Claude.ai Max bridge only; it is not invoked by this plan.

## Test families (12)
| ID | Family | Primary fixtures | Automatic | Advisory |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TF-01 | Full vs coherent-but-incomplete conjunction | FX-A | atom coverage, grammatical-prefix detection | paraphrase adequacy |
| TF-02 | Boolean/operator inversion | FX-B, FX-A | AND/OR flag per expected group | ambiguous grouping readings |
| TF-03 | Nested exceptions, exceptions-to-exceptions, waiver scope | FX-A, FX-B, FX-E | override-target set equality | scope paraphrase |
| TF-04 | External crossrefs vs invalid internal links | FX-B, FX-G, FX-S2 | unresolved marker present; no fabricated criteria; dangling-ID detection | plausibility of invented text |
| TF-05 | Modal strength and ambiguity | FX-C | modal label ∈ allowed set per sentence; contradiction preserved | reasonableness of uncertainty note |
| TF-06 | Current participation vs proposed duty | FX-C | status axis (proposed) attached to every duty | — |
| TF-07 | Independent clock/date/tz/receipt dimensions | FX-D | per-dimension equality incl. explicit absence | DST/offset inference flagged as added |
| TF-08 | Unicode exact evidence | FX-F | byte equality of evidence spans; declared offset unit; no NFC collapse; line-ending fidelity | — |
| TF-09 | Bounds B-1/B/B+1 and payload growth | FX-L, any | bounded-failure flag vs silent clip; growth ratio recorded | growth acceptability |
| TF-10 | Receipts, full-source coverage, truncation/receipt drift | FX-A-trunc, FX-R | receipt hash = fixture bytes; coverage map; drift detection | uncovered-span materiality |
| TF-11 | Member-scoped permissions and exception leakage | FX-E | permission×member matrix equality | — |
| TF-12 | Structure-only validity: cycles, dangling IDs, broken strings | FX-S1, FX-S2, FX-REG | cycle/dangling detection; string-health checks; constraint-survives-elsewhere | whether broken string was the only carrier |

## Pass/fail vocabulary (per fixture, not aggregate)
- PRESERVED: every expected atom, operator, scope target and dimension present, grounded, not inverted.
- BOUNDED-FAIL: implementation emits an explicit limit failure for a named unit; no partial string emitted for that unit.
- SILENT-LOSS: atom absent or shortened with no failure flag (semantic omission or clip indistinguishable by output alone — record which the implementation claims and whether the claim is checkable).
- INVERTED: operator, polarity, scope or modality contradicts fixture.
- FABRICATED: content not grounded in fixture bytes (e.g., resolved section 99).
No denominator inflation: a fixture reports its own atom set; families are not summed into a score.

## Execution notes for Codex (later)
- Run with `python -I`; fixtures live in their own directory; scripts elsewhere.
- Fixture bytes are canonical; compare evidence by bytes, not by normalized text.
- Where the implementation exposes no bound, TF-09 is recorded as NOT-EXPOSED, not passed.

fixtures.source: F-A verbatim (fictional): An eligible district may collect an enrollment fee only for a child enrolled in a classroom receiving state funding, provided the district has published a sliding schedule, given the family written notice in an accessible language, offered a hardship review without requiring an application fee, and separately recorded collections by program year. No fee may be charged to a child eligible for but not yet placed in Program Oak or Program Pine, or to a child with a disability entitled to free appropriate public education. The hardship review waives the published-schedule condition only; it does not waive the no-fee protections or the separate-accounting condition.

expected.permission: district MAY collect enrollment fee (permissive, 'may ... only')
necessary_conditions_all_required: A2 child enrolled in a classroom receiving state funding
A3 district has published a sliding schedule
A4 family given written notice in an accessible language
A5 hardship review offered without requiring an application fee
A6 collections separately recorded by program year
absolute_exclusions_not_waivable: X1 child eligible for but not yet placed in Program Oak
X2 child eligible for but not yet placed in Program Pine
X3 child with a disability entitled to free appropriate public education
expected.operator_over_X: OR (any exclusion blocks fee); Oak/Pine is a disjunction inside X1/X2

waiver.note: hardship review is simultaneously a condition (A5) and a waiver mechanism; both roles must survive. Source is silent on A1, A2, A4 relative to the waiver; do not assert they are waivable or non-waivable beyond 'waives A3 only' (which implies not waived, with the explicit list being the stronger evidence).

evidence_spans: only for a child enrolled in a classroom receiving state funding
provided the district has published a sliding schedule
does not waive the no-fee protections or the separate-accounting condition

variants.spec: Truncate the first sentence after 'given the family written notice in an accessible language.' (replace trailing comma with period). Grammatical, coherent; drops A5, A6.
variants.expect: A5/A6 ABSENT from inventory is correct for this variant source; but when the FULL source is given and the implementation emits the prefix string as the qualification, that is SILENT-LOSS. Automatic: atom coverage against metadata of the actual source fed.

variants.spec: Three sub-variants each deleting one clause: A3, A4, or A6 (comma-join repaired). Tests independent clause detection.
variants.expect: Inventory for each sub-variant must omit exactly the deleted atom and nothing else. Automatic.

variants.spec: Replace ', and separately recorded' with ', or separately recorded'.
variants.expect: Operator over A3..A6 group recorded as OR (or flagged ambiguous with uncertainty); treating as AND is INVERTED. Automatic flag; advisory on ambiguity note.

variants.spec: Replace 'waives the published-schedule condition only' with 'waives the published-schedule and separate-accounting conditions'.
variants.expect: waives_exactly = [A3, A6]; A6 still must not appear in does_not_waive. Automatic set equality.

variants.spec: Insert into A4 a 180-word parenthetical list of language-access requirements (generated, grounded in the variant file). Clause remains one condition.
variants.expect: Either full atom preserved or BOUNDED-FAIL for A4; never a shortened A4 string. Automatic: prefix/suffix check of emitted A4 against variant bytes.

variants.spec: Append a second paragraph restating A3 and A6 verbatim as conditions for a 'materials fee'.
variants.expect: Shared conditions represented many-to-many (same atom linked to both fee types) or duplicated; both fees link to A3 and A6. Automatic: link set per fee.

variants.spec: Feed source cut mid-word after 'offered a hardship rev'. Receipt must reflect the cut bytes.
variants.expect: Receipt hash equals cut bytes; inventory asserts nothing from the lost tail (no X1..X3, no waiver scope); truncation flagged as source-incomplete if implementation has such a notion. FABRICATED if waiver scope appears. Automatic.

automatic: prefix-truncation detection of emitted strings vs source
advisory: paraphrase adequacy of A4/A5 when not quoted
whether a merged A1+A2 unit is acceptable

fixtures.source: F-B verbatim: Eligibility requires A AND (B OR C). Disqualification D blocks eligibility unless waiver E is granted. E overrides D only; it does not override A or the requirement that B or C hold. Agency approval under section 7 is also required; section 7 is not supplied here.

expected.eligibility_formula: A AND (B OR C) AND NOT(D AND NOT E) AND approval(section 7)

operators.nesting: B OR C is nested under the AND; flattening to A AND B AND C or A OR B OR C is INVERTED

does_not_override: section 7 approval (not stated; do not assert either way)

external_ref.must_not: fabricate approval criteria or mark as satisfied/unsatisfied

variants.spec: Replace '(B OR C)' with '(B AND C)'.
variants.expect: BC_group = AND. Automatic.

variants.spec: Rewrite as '(A AND B) OR C' with explicit parentheses.
variants.expect: Different formula; A no longer necessary. Automatic: formula or equivalent structure comparison; advisory on representation.

variants.spec: Replace 'E overrides D only' with 'E overrides D and A'.
variants.expect: does_not_override excludes A. Automatic.

variants.spec: Append 'E also overrides A.' leaving the earlier 'does not override A' intact.
variants.expect: Both statements preserved and contradiction flagged; silently choosing one is INVERTED/SILENT-LOSS. Automatic presence of both; advisory on flag quality.

variants.spec: Generate formula depth 3/4/5: A AND (B OR (C AND (D OR F))) etc., with matching prose.
variants.expect: Structure preserved at each depth or BOUNDED-FAIL at a declared depth bound (probe B-1/B/B+1 if exposed). Automatic.

automatic: section 7 marked unresolved external, no criteria text

fixtures.source: F-C verbatim: Under the proposed rule, organizations must submit annual records if they served more than twenty participants AND received state funds; organizations receiving only private funds may submit records voluntarily. Organizations should retain supporting worksheets. Send requests to the office by the stated date. The last sentence does not specify whether its directive is mandatory or advisory.

expected.status_axis: every duty/permission tagged proposed (not current/in-force); dropping 'proposed' is SILENT-LOSS

duties.condition: served >20 participants AND received state funds
duties.threshold: more than twenty (strict >20; '20 or more' is INVERTED)

duties.d: C4 send requests to the office by the stated date
duties.deadline_ref: 'the stated date' unresolved internal/external reference; no date fabricated

evidence_spans: Send requests to the office by the stated date
does not specify whether its directive is mandatory or advisory

variants.spec: Swap 'must' and 'should' between C1 and C3.
variants.expect: Labels follow swap. Automatic.

variants.spec: Replace 'Under the proposed rule' with 'Under the current rule'; second sub-variant deletes the prefix entirely.
variants.expect: status = current / status = unspecified respectively; asserting 'proposed' absent evidence is FABRICATED. Automatic.

variants.spec: Append 'Retention of worksheets is mandatory.' after C3's 'should'.
variants.expect: Both modalities preserved with contradiction/uncertainty explicit. Automatic presence; advisory flag quality.

variants.spec: Replace 'more than twenty' with 'twenty or more' / 'at least 20' / 'fewer than twenty'.
variants.expect: Comparator preserved exactly. Automatic.

automatic: modal label per duty within allowed set

fixtures.source: F-D verbatim: Written comments open on March 2, 2032, at 8:00 a.m. and are due by March 30, 2032, at 5:00 p.m.; no timezone or receipt/postmark rule is supplied. Mailed permit applications must be postmarked by April 2, 2032. Electronic permit applications must be received by April 2, 2032, at 17:00 Eastern Time. Assistance requests should be made by March 23, 2032. In-person arrival must occur at 09:00 UTC on April 3, 2032.

expected_time_facts.tz: Eastern Time (verbatim; offset resolution is an added inference and must be flagged if emitted)

fixtures.rules: Absence is a value. Filling an absent tz (e.g., defaulting D2 to Eastern because D4 says Eastern) is FABRICATED. Converting D6 to local time is an added inference and must not replace the UTC fact. D3 vs D4 share a date but differ in rule and clock; merging them is SILENT-LOSS.

variants.spec: Swap 'Eastern Time' and 'UTC' between D4 and D6.
variants.expect: tz follows swap. Automatic.

variants.spec: Swap 'postmarked' and 'received' between D3 and D4.
variants.expect: rule follows swap. Automatic.

variants.spec: Remove 'a.m.'/'p.m.' from D1/D2.
variants.expect: clock recorded as ambiguous 8:00/5:00 with uncertainty, not assumed 24h. Automatic allowed-set; advisory wording.

variants.spec: Change D6 'at 09:00 UTC' to 'by 09:00 UTC'.
variants.expect: rule changes from point-in-time to deadline. Automatic.

variants.spec: Render D4 as '2 April 2032 17:00 ET' and D3 as '04/02/2032'.
variants.expect: Same facts; ambiguity of 04/02 (MM/DD vs DD/MM) flagged if implementation normalizes; verbatim retention acceptable. Advisory.

fixtures.source: F-E verbatim: For members A and B the reduction is allowed when X holds; for member C the reduction is allowed only when Y AND Z hold. Exception Q applies only to member B. No statement permits Q to replace Y or Z for member C. A shared contact address alone does not make these permissions interchangeable.
fixtures.notes: 'allowed when X' (A,B) vs 'allowed only when Y AND Z' (C): the 'only' makes C's condition necessary; for A/B, X is sufficient and the source does not say 'only' — an implementation may mark A/B necessity as unspecified. Shared contact address is a non-condition; emitting it as a permission link is FABRICATED.

variants.spec: Change 'applies only to member B' to 'applies to members B and C'.
variants.expect: C.exceptions=[Q]; 'no statement permits Q to replace Y or Z' still preserved (Q applies to C but does not substitute). Automatic matrix.

variants.spec: Delete 'only' from C's clause.
variants.expect: C necessity becomes unspecified; forcing 'only' is INVERTED. Automatic allowed-set.

variants.spec: Add 'Members B and C share a mailing address and a contact person.'
variants.expect: No permission crossover inferred. Automatic matrix equality.

advisory: sufficiency vs necessity labeling for A/B

fixtures.source: F-F content: the literal line 'Café / Café / 中文 / 🫧' where the first Café uses U+00E9 (precomposed) and the second uses 'e' U+0065 + U+0301 (combining acute). Fixture file stores exact bytes and a sidecar listing codepoints and UTF-8 byte offsets.

expected.evidence_byte_equality: any emitted evidence span for these tokens must byte-equal the fixture bytes
expected.no_normalization_collapse: the two Café forms remain distinct (different byte length 5 vs 6 in UTF-8); an inventory that treats them as one token or emits one form for both is a normalization failure
expected.offset_unit_declared: offsets must declare unit (byte|codepoint|utf16). Sidecar provides expected offsets in all three units; 🫧 (U+1FAE7) is 4 UTF-8 bytes, 1 codepoint, 2 UTF-16 units — mismatches identify the confusion type
expected.line_endings: generated variant lines joined by CRLF, LF, U+2028, U+2029, U+0085 in a known sequence; evidence spans crossing a boundary must retain the exact separator

variants.spec: Provide a second copy of the line NFC-normalized elsewhere in the source.
variants.expect: Each occurrence grounded to its own bytes; cross-linking as 'same text' allowed only with explicit normalized-match note. Automatic byte check.

variants.spec: Place 🫧 before a qualification clause so that byte/codepoint/utf16 offsets diverge by known deltas (3/0/1).
variants.expect: Emitted offsets consistent with declared unit. Automatic.

variants.spec: Put a qualification clause split across a CRLF and across U+2028.
variants.expect: Clause preserved whole; separator bytes preserved in evidence or clause spans quoted without separator loss. Automatic.

fixtures.source: F-G verbatim: See section 99 for the fee exemption. Section 99 is not in this notice. Two local facts refer to this same unavailable section. Preserve the crossreference and unavailable content, not invented exemption criteria or a fabricated resolved prerequisite.

crossref.referrers: two local facts (fixture file names them G1, G2 with grounded spans)

must_not: convert the two referrers into a resolved prerequisite chain
emit a 'false unknown' that erases the reference itself
expected.many_to_many: G1 and G2 both link to one unresolved target; duplicating the target is acceptable, inventing two different targets is not

variants.spec: Append a one-line 'Section 99: exemption applies to ...' truncated mid-phrase.
variants.expect: Partial content preserved as partial with truncation evident; not completed. Automatic prefix check; advisory on labeling.

variants.spec: Add a real internal 'section 12' defined in the same source and referenced by G2.
variants.expect: section 12 link resolvable and resolved; section 99 remains unresolved; distinction explicit. Automatic.

automatic: no criteria text absent from source
advisory: plausibility audit of any explanatory text

fixtures.source: Synthetic regression fixture modeled on the supplied public pattern (data, not a new evaluation). Base text = F-A. Planted output (not source) under test: five qualification strings ending in (1) dangling punctuation ', and', (2) partial phrase 'without requiring an', (3) non-source katakana 'ハードシップ審査', (4) comma-terminated 'provided the district has published a sliding schedule,', (5) empty string with a valid ID.
fixtures.purpose: Validate string-health checks against a known-bad output shape, and validate that the checker does NOT count every broken string as an absent function.

expected_checker_behaviour.flag_each_string: all five flagged (dangling terminator, non-terminal fragment, script not in source script set and not marked translation, trailing comma, empty)
expected_checker_behaviour.constraint_survival: for each flagged string, locate whether the same atom (A3, A5) survives intact in another assertion; report SURVIVES-ELSEWHERE vs ONLY-CARRIER-BROKEN
expected_checker_behaviour.no_double_count: fixture metadata lists atoms; broken strings map to atoms; absence is judged per atom, not per string

variants.spec: String (4) rewritten as 'provided the district has published a sliding schedule' (no trailing comma).
variants.expect: Passes string-health; still SILENT-LOSS vs full A3..A6 group if emitted as the whole qualification — shows health checks are insufficient alone. Automatic coverage.

variants.spec: Katakana string accompanied by explicit translation marker and grounded source span.
variants.expect: Not flagged as non-source script. Automatic.

advisory: whether a surviving paraphrase is adequate

fixtures.source: Structure-only fixture: a small valid inventory derived from F-B, then mutated. Mutations: (a) dependency cycle A→B→C→A among condition units; (b) self-link; (c) duplicate IDs; (d) dangling link to ID 'cond-404'.

expected.detection: cycle, self-link, duplicate, dangling each detected deterministically
expected.non_normative: structural dependency links are not normative prerequisites; the checker must not infer that a dangling link means a missing source condition, nor that an acyclic graph means conditions are complete
expected.separation: structural report emitted separately from semantic report

variants.spec: Fully valid graph whose nodes carry no qualification text.
variants.expect: Structural PASS, semantic SILENT-LOSS for all atoms. Automatic both.

automatic: independence of structural and semantic verdicts

fixtures.source: Generated from F-A: qualification A4 padded to lengths L-1, L, L+1 for each exposed bound L (field length, unit count, request size, nesting depth, graph edge count). Padding text is grounded in the variant file.

expected.at_L+1: BOUNDED-FAIL for the named unit with no partial string; or PRESERVED if the bound is soft — never a shortened string
expected.payload_growth: record output bytes / source bytes per variant; growth is reported, not scored; a growth cliff coinciding with a bound suggests re-emission or repair and is flagged advisory
expected.distinguish: serialization failure (explicit, unit-named) vs semantic omission (unflagged). If the implementation cannot name the failing unit, record LIMIT-UNATTRIBUTED
expected.token_caveat: local byte/char/token sensitivity numbers are estimates; no matched-tokenizer or live output-fit claim is made

variants.spec: Implementation exposes no bound.
variants.expect: Family recorded NOT-EXPOSED; probe with escalating lengths 1k/4k/16k/64k bytes to locate behaviour empirically, still offline. Automatic recording; advisory interpretation.

fixtures.source: Receipt/coverage fixture: F-A + F-D concatenated with known byte length and SHA-256 recorded in sidecar.

expected.receipt: inventory receipt hash equals sidecar hash of exactly the bytes fed
expected.coverage_map: every expected atom maps to a span inside [0, len); union of grounded spans reported; uncovered spans listed (not scored)
drift_cases: R-drift-1: feed bytes B but implementation receipts hash(B') where B' = B with CRLF→LF: must be detected as drift
R-drift-2: feed truncated B[0:n]; receipt must hash the truncated bytes, and no atom beyond n may appear
R-drift-3: feed B with one condition deleted; receipt changes and exactly that atom disappears

fixtures.source: Mixed-reference fixture: F-C 'the stated date' (unresolved, internal-or-external unclear), F-G section 99 (external unavailable), F-B section 7 (external unavailable), plus a synthetic internal 'see paragraph 2' that resolves within the fixture.

forbidden: a single generic 'unknown' that discards the target identifier
treating an invalid internal link (dangling ID) as an external crossreference or vice versa

automatic: class per reference within allowed set

preserved_invariants: Expected qualifications are grounded in exact fixture bytes; evidence comparisons are byte-level, never normalized.
Absence is a value (tz, clock, receipt rule, modality strength, status axis). Filling an absence is FABRICATED, erasing it is SILENT-LOSS.
Operators (AND/OR), nesting shape, comparators (>20 vs ≥20), scope targets (waives exactly / does not waive) and member×permission matrices are compared as sets or shapes, not prose.
Unresolved references retain their target identifier and unresolved status; no criteria are invented; one unavailable target may have many referrers (many-to-many).
A broken qualification string is flagged but is not counted as an absent source function until atom-level survival is checked.
Structural validity (acyclic, no dangling IDs, roundtrip) and semantic completeness are reported as independent verdicts; structural links are not normative prerequisites.
Every exposed bound is probed at B-1/B/B+1; the only acceptable B+1 outcomes are PRESERVED or explicit BOUNDED-FAIL naming the unit; shortened or repaired strings are failures.
Serialization-limit failure and semantic omission are recorded as distinct outcomes; LIMIT-UNATTRIBUTED when the implementation cannot name the unit.
Receipts hash exactly the bytes fed; truncation or line-ending drift must change the receipt.
No aggregate accuracy score or inflated denominator; verdicts are per fixture, per atom.
Tier A deterministic checks run only on authored fixtures with metadata; Tier B unseen-source completeness is advisory and reviewed by AI/human.

Alternative justified interpretations with explicit uncertainty are acceptable where the fixture marks ambiguity (F-C last sentence, F-D a.m./p.m. drop, F-E A/B necessity, 'the stated date' class); a forced label or a blanket 'unknown' that discards the referent is not.
No live experiment, no provider call, no credentials, no OpenRouter route; Claude route is the Claude.ai Max bridge only and is not part of this plan.
Earlier artifacts remain immutable; all new material goes under round15-condition-preservation/testing/.
unresolved_implementation_dependent_choi: How qualifications are represented (quoted span, paraphrase, logical form, graph) — the plan accepts any representation that passes atom/operator/scope equality; mapping from representation to atoms must be supplied by the implementation or authored per fixture by Codex.
Which bounds exist and are exposed (field length, unit count, request size, depth, edge count, token budget); TF-09 is NOT-EXPOSED until declared.
Whether the implementation has an explicit bounded-failure signal and whether it names the failing unit.
Offset unit (byte/codepoint/UTF-16) — any is acceptable if declared; undeclared offsets are checked against all three to classify confusion.
How contradictions and modality ambiguity are expressed (dual assertion, uncertainty field, note) — presence is automatic, form is advisory.
Whether shared conditions are linked many-to-many or duplicated per referrer — both accepted; link-set equality is what is checked.
Whether a merged unit (e.g., A1+A2) counts as preserving both atoms — default accept if both atoms are recoverable from the unit's grounded span; otherwise advisory.
Receipt hash algorithm and whether receipts cover the pre- or post-chunking bytes — must be declared; fixture sidecar records SHA-256 of the raw bytes.
Handling of 'proposed' status: whether it is a per-assertion field or a document-level flag — accepted either way provided it is attached to every duty when checked.
Whether Tier B unseen-source review uses an AI reviewer on the Claude.ai Max bridge or human review only — reviewer selection is out of scope here and requires separate authorization.
